newsitem.title: DENMARK: Rieber has 25.7 pct of Phoenix.
newsitem.headline: Rieber has 25.7 pct of Phoenix.

text.p: Norway's Rieber and Son said on Friday that its stake in takeover target Phoenix Contractors had risen to 25.7 percent of equity and 23.1 percent of voting stock.

The announcement, in a statement to the Copenhagen Stock Exchange, came shortly after Rieber raised its bid for the Danish roadbuilder to 875.8 million crowns, matching a rival offer by Denmark's Icopal.
It said that the holding was equal to 26.5 percent of equity and 26.1 percent of votes if one did not count Phoenix' own holding.
Phoenix management and staff support the Phoenix bid as likely to mean the least upheaval and job losses if successful.
Another stock exchange notice said that the JOP pension fund had cut its shareholding below five percent, from 6.4 percent.
